chat_members_left_ck.name: chat_members_left_ck
chat_members_left_ck.value: ("chat_members"."left_at" is null) = ("chat_members"."left_seq" is null) and ("chat_members"."left_at" is null) = ("chat_members"."left_reason" is null)

chats_space_cols_ck.name: chats_space_cols_ck
chats_space_cols_ck.value: "chats"."type" in ('space_text', 'space_voice', 'space_forum', 'space_stage') or ("chats"."category_id" is null and "chats"."position" is null and "chats"."topic" is null and "chats"."user_limit" is null)

chats_announcement_ck.name: chats_announcement_ck
chats_announcement_ck.value: not "chats"."is_announcement" or ("chats"."community_id" is not null and "chats"."invite_code" is null)

message_bookmarks_due_idx.name: message_bookmarks_due_idx
message_bookmarks_due_idx.where: "message_bookmarks"."remind_at" is not null and "message_bookmarks"."reminded_at" is null

messages_poll_open_idx.name: messages_poll_open_idx
messages_poll_open_idx.where: "messages"."poll_ends_at" is not null and "messages"."poll_closed_at" is null

spaces_tag_ck.name: spaces_tag_ck
spaces_tag_ck.value: ("spaces"."tag" is null) = ("spaces"."tag_badge" is null) and ("spaces"."tag" is null) = ("spaces"."tag_color" is null) and ("spaces"."tag" is null or char_length("spaces"."tag") between 2 and 4) and ("spaces"."tag_color" is null or "spaces"."tag_color" ~ '^#[0-9a-f]{6}$')
